text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: inference-service v2.13 -> canary (10%) starting 2025-08-31 22:00 UTC. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Release notes: https://dash.redwood.com/releases/1748803200. @emma @raj :eyes:

emma: Quick plan: enable ff_infer_v2_canary at 10% for 10m health check. If error_rate < 0.5% and p95 latency < 200ms, ramp to 50%. Rollback if error_rate > 1% for 5m. Pin fallback to model=v2.12. Keep other flags untouched.

raj: LGTM. Add a config pin so traffic can be force-routed to v2.12 if we need to fall back: pinned_model=v2.12. Also confirm grafana dashboards and incident playbook links.

sara: I'll run the rollout and monitor. Command I'm going to use:
```
/ff toggle ff_infer_v2_canary --env=prod --percent=10 --actor=@sara
```
I'll post updates here.

mike: +1. Suggest disabling streaming response on canary to reduce surface area for early errors (ff_streaming=false for canary).

deploy-bot: Action: feature flag toggled ff_infer_v2_canary -> 10% by @sara. Start ts=1748803200.

sara: Started synthetic smoke (QPS 200, representative prompts). Watching p50/p95 and error_rate.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: inference_errors > 1% for 5m -> post to #incidents and trigger rollback script (rollback-runbook v1.3).

emma: Rollback steps (if triggered):
1) disable ff_infer_v2_canary (set percent=0)
2) pin service config to model=v2.12 (immediate)
3) cut canary traffic entirely and re-route to dedicated pool
4) open rollback incident and assign oncall
Please follow the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/inference-rollback

raj: Note for the record: don't change autoscaler or batch size during this ramp. Those changes require a separate change window.

mike: small p95 blip at +6m -> 230ms, p50 steady. Not triggering alarms yet.

sara: +12m: p95 back to 190ms, error_rate 0.12%. Ramping to 50% now. Command:
```
/ff toggle ff_infer_v2_canary --env=prod --percent=50 --actor=@sara
```

deploy-bot: Action: feature flag toggled ff_infer_v2_canary -> 50% by @sara. Current rollout: 50%.

ops-bot: No alerts fired during the last 20m. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/inference-overview

emma: If metrics remain stable for 30m at 50%, we proceed to full release and remove the canary flag. If anything degrades, follow rollback steps above. Also add a changelog entry after full release.

raj: Added brief note to changelog: inference-service v2.13 canary -> 50% (see release notes link). Don't forget to pin versions in client SDKs if we change API surface.

mike: :rocket: All good from infra side, oncall please watch next hour.

sara: will keep an eye and post final status in 30m.
